description:
Your new job

As an ABAP Developer SAP EWM (all genders), you will work with your team to design and implement creative and innovative solutions for mapping logistics processes in SAP Extended Warehouse Management. You will collaborate closely with our consultants and participate in cross-national projects. Your main tasks will include developing ABAP OO as part of software implementations for customer companies across various industries.

Depending on your professional focus, you will concentrate on one of the following areas:

  • Implementation of mobile applications (RF Framework, ITSmobile, etc.)
  • Form printing (RFID label printing, SAP Smart Forms, Adobe Interactive Forms)
  • Material flow systems (MFS) in SAP EWM
  • Development of web and Fiori applications with SAPUI5

At the same time, you will be preparing for your next career step. You will have the opportunity to take on more technical responsibilities or develop towards project management or team leadership. As only limited travel is required, for example for go-live support, you have the flexibility to work either in the office in Braşov or from home.

What we expect

  • Development experience in logistics
  • Strong ABAP OO skills in SAP EWM
  • S/4HANA experience is a plus
  • Strong communication and analytical skills, high commitment
  • Good German – spoken and written

What we offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits & Wellbeing, e.g. meal vouchers, private pension contributions, medical services, gym subsidies
  • iPhone also provided for private use
  • Team and company events in Germany and Romania, including annual company travel in Europe or worldwide
  • Individual career plans, ongoing education, annual feedback discussions, and opportunities to work with the latest SAP technologies on exciting projects
  • Flexible working hours and mobile work options
  • Join a leading company with strong SAP EWM expertise and a culture encouraging creativity and professional growth

Von der Ausgründung aus dem Fraunhofer-Institut für Materialfluss und Logistik (IML) bis zum Powerhouse für Beratung, Entwicklung und Wissenstransfer zu SAP EWM, SAP TM, SAP S/4HANA & Co. – spannender Kunden und ausgezeichnetem Teamwork sei Dank: Das ist prismat!

Connecte dich und werde Teil unseres Teams!
